page.notes: The "»" marks at the start of each line are printed as a running quotation mark; they are transcribed as printed. The running head at the right is heavy, partly blackletter-like type and could not be read reliably; it is marked illegible. The word "bëret" is doubtful and marked [?]. The page is printed with the long s as "f" in "fcapha" and "fcripto" and similar words; these are transcribed as "s" where the context requires it (scaphā, scripto), with the printed spelling otherwise kept.
